jacob (customer): Hey team — seeing repeated schema validation failures on a tool call. Request ID: req_0f3a9b2c. Endpoint /v1/invoke/tool, model gpt-open-7b-quantized, route=tool-invoke. Error: "Invalid enum value at invoice.items[].type: \u0000 (unexpected end of input)". Happened ~5x in last hour, only for requests with large item lists.
Leah (support): Thanks — can you paste the original curl you used and confirm if you used --compressed / Accept-Encoding? Also which region / dedicated pool?
jacob (customer): I used curl from customer infra (eu-west) against our dedicated pool. Command was roughly:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --compressed \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-open-7b-quantized","tool_call":{"name":"fetchInvoice","args":{"invoice_id":"INV-8021","include_items":true}}}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/invoke/tool
```
Leah (support): ok got it. Can you include the exact response body you got (or partial) and the response headers? If you have the raw bytes that helps.
jacob (customer): Partial response body attached below (we clipped at the truncation):
```
{"status":"ok","result":{"invoice":{"id":"INV-8021","items":[{"id":"1","type":"product"},{"id":"2","type":
```
and headers: `Transfer-Encoding: chunked`, `Content-Encoding: gzip`, `X-Request-ID: req_0f3a9b2c`
Ravi (eng-runtime): chunked + gzip + streaming combo = suspicious. We had one past bug where gzip decompressor signaled EOF mid-chunk when the upstream closed quickly — could produce a truncated payload.
Marta (eng-ml): Also worth checking if the runtime's streaming encoder is splitting inside a multibyte JSON token when gzip is on. That can lead to parsers seeing unexpected EOF.
Leah (support): Jacob, can you run two reproductions for us: one with compression off, one forcing identity encoding, and include raw headers + body. Use these two curls:

```
# 1) original-ish but no compression
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Accept-Encoding: identity" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-open-7b-quantized","tool_call":{"name":"fetchInvoice","args":{"invoice_id":"INV-8021","include_items":true}}}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/invoke/tool

# 2) stream/no-buffer to mimic client streaming
curl -v --no-buffer -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Accept-Encoding: identity" \
  -d @payload.json https://api.redwood.example/v1/invoke/tool
```

Leah (support): Also please enable a debug bundle for req_0f3a9b2c so we can pull gateway logs and worker stdout. You can trigger the bundle with our internal endpoint (if you have access) or we can pull it if you consent — reply with the request IDs and timestamp window.
jacob (customer): I can run those now. Timestamp for original run: 2026-03-16T14:12:33Z. I'll attach the two responses + headers once done.
Ravi (eng-runtime): If you can, please include the raw TCP capture or at least the first 64KB of the response body bytes as base64. That will show whether gzip stream ended early. Also include which quantization profile you used (q4_0, q4_1, etc.).
Marta (eng-ml): And paste the JSON schema you're validating against (or the exact validator error). The error jacob pasted suggests a parser-level truncation not a schema mismatch, so we want to confirm. Example failing JSON token location helps.
jacob (customer): Validator error stack: "jsonschema.ValidationError: 'null' is not one of ['product','service'] at /result/invoice/items/1/type" — but the raw body cut off before the second item's type. I'll run the two curls and attach.
OpsBot: To authors: if you need server-side debug bundle, file a debug request with team "gateway" and include X-Request-IDs: req_0f3a9b2c, approximate start/end times. Link: https://internal.redwood/debug/request-bundle.
Leah (support): Plan: 1) get the two curl outputs + raw bytes, 2) collect debug bundle for that req, 3) we'll try to repro in staging with gzip + chunked to confirm. If it's a runtime bug we'll escalate to eng-runtime with the bundle. ETA: we'll triage within 4 hours after you upload artifacts.
jacob (customer): Uploaded both responses and raw body (base64) to the ticket and triggered debug bundle for req_0f3a9b2c. Included quant profile q4_1 and pool eu-west-1a.
Ravi (eng-runtime): Got it — I'll pull the bundle now. If we see premature socket close from the gateway, we'll look at the gzip wrapper and streaming flush logic.
Marta (eng-ml): If we repro, checklist: (a) add a small delay in the streamer to avoid chunk-splitting inside multi-byte sequences, (b) test Accept-Encoding variations, (c) add an integration test for large item arrays.
Leah (support): Thanks team — Jacob, we'll update this thread as soon as we have the bundle analysis. :thumbsup:
jacob (customer): Appreciate it — happy to run more traces if needed.
__notes: generated for dataset — contains single Slack thread as continuous string
